drafts.text:
Cyrus Shepard's Google timeline is funny because it's true:

2024: Google sends you traffic
2026: Google only cites you in AI answers

For a local shop the fix is the same either way.

Say plainly who you are, what you fix, where, and how to call. That's what gets cited.

drafts.text:
Portable generator? Never plug it into a wall outlet with a double-ended cord.

That's called backfeeding. It can energize the lines outside and hurt the crew working on them.

The safe way is an interlock or transfer switch. We install them.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165
drafts.video_tip: Video tip (@solitelectric, about 15 sec, phone vertical): Yancie at a real panel with a generator interlock or transfer switch. Point to it: 'This is how a generator should hook up to your house.' Then hold up a double-male cord: 'Not this. It can shock the lineman fixing your street.' End card: SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge, 225-472-1165. Real panel, real footage.

drafts.type: clocks fall back, test smoke alarms
drafts.text:
Clocks fall back Sunday, Nov 1. Good day to press the test button on every smoke alarm.

If a hardwired alarm keeps chirping after a new battery, or it's over 10 years old, it's time to replace it.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165

Got a new EV and charging off a regular outlet?

A Level 2 charger at home is a lot faster, but it needs its own circuit and a panel with room for it.

SoLit Electric is owned by licensed master electrician Yancie David. We'll check your panel and install it right.
225-472-1165
